name: cynosure-desktop
description: Cynosure Desktop — Electron wrapper for Cynosure server + web UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c blue,green "cd ../web && pnpm dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron-vite dev"
scripts.prebuild:deps: pnpm --filter cynosure-web build && pnpm --filter cynosure-server build
scripts.package: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-deps.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-deps.mjs && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:win: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-deps.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run prebuild:deps && pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-deps.mjs && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:skip-deps: pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-deps.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
